prose:
Cory Doctorow’s Pluralistic post reviews Lisa Hanawalt’s graphic memoir through its treatment of relationships, horses and bodily experience. The examined opening is a cultural review rather than an AI technology report.

Its presence in a broad feed does not justify inventing an AI connection. The summary describes the reviewed themes without independently verifying biographical details or treating the reviewer’s judgments as objective rankings.
highlights: Relationships and horses organize the account
Artistic judgments belong to the reviewer
Full later links roundup was not examined
